items.raw_excerpt: Flowing beautifully through the heart of the Templar city of Tomar, the Rio Nabão is currently undergoing an environmental revival.
items.summary_en: Workers and volunteers are cleaning the Rio Nabao river in Tomar, a Templar town in Portugal. The river is getting an environmental revival after years of neglect. The cleanup aims to bring the water and local life back to the river.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈의 템플러 도시 투마르를 지나는 나방강을 청소하는 작업이 진행되고 있다. 이 강은 오랜 방치 뒤 환경 회복기에 들어갔다. 이번 정화 작업은 깨끗한 물과 생물을 강으로 되돌리는 것을 목표로 한다.
items.title_en: Cleaning Up the Rio Nabao River in Tomar
items.title_original: Cleaning up the River Nabão in Tomar

items.raw_excerpt: Calvyn Gilfellan, says Krotoa's story continues to carry significance beyond its historical context
items.summary_en: A new painting of Krotoa was unveiled in Cape Town this week. Krotoa was a Khoi woman who worked as a language interpreter at the Cape. The painting was shown at events for Heritage Day, a South African national holiday.
items.summary_ko: 케이프타운에서 크로투아를 그린 새 그림이 공개됐습니다. 크로투아는 케이프 지역에서 통역으로 일했던 코이 여성입니다. 이 그림은 남아프리카의 공식 국경일인 문화의 달 기념 행회에서 공개됐습니다.
items.title_en: New painting of Krotoa unveiled in Cape Town
items.title_original: New Krotoa painting unveiled in CT amid Heritage Day celebrations

items.raw_excerpt: Sept 24 : Matthew Breetzke scored a superb 112 to guide South Africa to a 67-run victory over Australia in the first one-day international in Durban on Thursday, but the tourists will rue the loss of cheap wickets as they faltered in their chase.South Africa posted 297 for eight in their 50 overs and Australi
items.summary_en: Matthew Breetzke scored 112 runs for South Africa in a one-day match against Australia. South Africa won by 67 runs after Australia lost cheap wickets while chasing. Australia also lost one of their openers to injury during the match.
items.summary_ko: 매튜 브리츠케가 남아프리카 대표로 112점을 득점했다. 남아프리카는 67점 차이로 호주 팀을 이겼다. 호주는 추격 중 헛디딱을 내줘 점수를 따라잡지 못했다.
items.title_en: Breetzke's 112 Runs Lead South Africa to a 67-Run Win
items.title_original: Breetzke ton leads South Africa to 67-run win over Australia

items.raw_excerpt: Macklemore has announced a Dublin concert as part of his new Free Palestine Tour, following his removal from the remaining dates of Ed Sheeran's US tour earlier this month.
items.summary_en: American rapper Macklemore has added a Dublin concert to his new Free Palestine Tour. He was dropped from the rest of Ed Sheeran's US tour earlier this month. Fans in Ireland can now book tickets for the new Dublin date.
items.summary_ko: 미국 래퍼 매클모어가 새 프리 팔레스틴 투어에 더블린 공연을 추가했다. 그는 이번 달 초 에드 셰이런의 미국 투어 남은 일정에서 제외된 상태였다. 아일랜드 관객은 이제 더블린 공연표를 예매할 수 있다.
items.title_en: Macklemore adds Dublin show to Free Palestine tour

items.raw_excerpt: A former government building in Lisbon is set to be turned into around 90 homes, most of them one-bedroom properties aimed at public-sector workers struggling to find affordable accommodation in the capital.
items.summary_en: A former government building in Lisbon will be turned into about 90 new homes. Most of them are small one-bedroom flats for public workers. The city has very few cheap homes near the center, so many workers commute from far away.
items.summary_ko: 리스본의 옛 정부청사 건물이 약 90채의 주택으로 바뀐다. 대부분은 한 방짜리 작은 아파트로 방송 beginnings 아니다. 이 집들은 도심에서 값싼 집을 찾기 어려운 공무원과 공공기관 근로자를 위해 지어진다.
items.title_en: Old Government Office in Lisbon Becomes 90 Homes
items.title_original: Former Portugal Government building to become 90 homes

items.raw_excerpt: Gray retailer recognized for service innovation, broad capabilities and commitment to meeting the needs of southern Maine GRAY — Gray Village
items.summary_en: Gray Village Hardware in Gray, Maine, was named Maine's 2026 HBSDealer All Star. The award honors stores with good service, wide product range, and care for their community. The shop is a family business serving the southern Maine area.

items.title_en: A Small Hardware Store Wins a Big Maine Award
